main.description: List indexed occurrence records, most recently indexed first. Reads from the bio.lexicons.temp.v0-1.occurrence collection. Requires no user authentication.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor taken from a previous response. Present only while more records remain.

did.description: Only return occurrences authored by this DID.

uri.description: Fetch a single occurrence by AT URI instead of listing. When supplied, the response carries record rather than records.

records.description: Indexed occurrences, each carrying its AT URI alongside the record fields.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Absent when no further records remain.

record.description: The single occurrence addressed by the uri parameter.
